title: Data Lead
description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.

At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Data Lead with strong expertise in Microsoft Fabric, enterprise data strategy, data governance, metadata management and Oracle technologies. The ideal candidate will **enhancing and scaling the** enterprise data archietcture, **enhancing** data standards and governance frameworks and **enhancing** modern analytics and AI-driven solutions using Microsoft Fabric, OneLake and Microsoft AI technologies.

This role requires deep technical knowledge in data modeling, metadata management, data lineage, data catalog implementation and Oracle SQL/PLSQL development. The Data Lead will collaborate with business stakeholders, data engineers, analysts, governance teams and enterprise Leads to deliver secure, scalable and high-quality data solutions.

Data Lead is responsible for data strategy that is in line with organisation processes. The strategy includes data model designs, creating and maintaining data dictionary and MDM. You will be responsible for analysing requirements, designing data models and ensuring data integrity and security. You will play a crucial part in designing and optimizing conceptual and logical database models**.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

Enterprise Data Lead

  

* Maintain & enhance enterprise wide data Architecture strategies aligned with business goals.
* Define scalable data models, integration patterns and modern data platform architecture.
* Maintain & enhance architecture standards, best practices and reusable frameworks.
* Maintain & enhance cloud data modernization initiatives using Microsoft Fabric.
* Maintain & enhance Lakehouse, Data Warehouse and Medallion architecture.
* Ensure data solutions are scalable, secure, performant and compliant.
* Maintain & enhance AI-ready enterprise data architectures supporting machine learning and generative AI workloads.
* **E**nhance trusted and governed AI solutions through high-quality, well-managed enterprise data.
* Collaborate with AI/ML teams to support model training, feature engineering and AI data pipelines.
* Implement scalable data foundations for predictive analytics, intelligent automationand AI-driven insights.

Microsoft Fabric, OneLake & Microsoft Purview

  

* Architect and implement solutions using Microsoft Fabric components including:
* + Data Factory
  + Data Engineering
  + Data Science
  + Real Time Analytics
  + Power BI
  + Lakehouse
* Maintain & enhance enterprise data storage architecture using OneLake.
* Implement enterprise governance, compliance and data discovery solutions using Microsoft Purview.
* Maintain & enhance unified analytics platforms leveraging Fabric capabilities.
* Maintain & enhance data ingestion, transformation, orchestration and semantic models in Fabric.
* Optimize Fabric workloads for performance, governance and cost efficiency.
* Configure and manage Microsoft Purview for data governance, classification, lineage, cataloging and compliance management.

Metadata Management, Data Catalog

  

* Establish master data management (MDM) and reference data management standards.
* Drive data stewardship and governance adoption across business domains.

* Design and implement enterprise metadata management frameworks.
* Build and maintain business and technical metadata repositories.
* Implement enterprise data catalog solutions using Microsoft Purview and related governance platforms.
* Define metadata standards, naming conventions and classification models.
* Enable data discoverability, trust and self-service analytics.

Data Lineage, Data Dictionary & Compliance

  

* Establish end-to-end data lineage capabilities across enterprise systems.
* Create and maintain enterprise data dictionaries and business glossaries.
* Document source-to-target mappings and transformation logic.
* Ensure traceability and impact analysis across data pipelines.
* Support regulatory and audit requirements through lineage documentation.

Data Modeling

  

* Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
* Develop dimensional models for analytics and reporting.
* Design normalized and denormalized data structures.
* Implement enterprise data standards and modeling best practices.
* Work closely with development teams to ensure proper implementation.

Collaboration & Leadership

  

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand data requirements.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineering teams.
* Conduct architecture reviews and solution assessments.
* Participate in project planning, estimation and technical governance.
* Communicate architecture decisions and technical roadmaps to leadership.

Essential:

* 5-8 years’ experience in similar role
* Fluency in English (written and verbal)
* University degree in Computer Science or related subjects

Highly Beneficial

* Azure BI technology (Synapse, Power BI, Azure SQL, SSIS, SSAS, Purview, OneLake, ADF)
* Microsoft training/certification on DP-203 or DP-500
* Generative AI
* Azure AI & Machine Learning

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

title: AppModernization_Agentic_AI_Solution_Architect
description:
Overview
  
The primary responsibility of this role is to act as a GCP Agentic Product Engineer for medium-to-large AI transformation opportunities, supporting mid-sized clients in designing reusable AI-enabled assets, engineering cloud-native AI products, developing agentic workflows, and establishing scalable deployment frameworks on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The role focuses on creating reusable, commercially viable AI solutions that accelerate time-to-value, improve business outcomes, and can be rapidly deployed across multiple client engagements.
  
The ideal candidate will leverage strong product engineering, cloud development, and AI expertise to build scalable agentic AI assets, collaborate with architects and business stakeholders, establish engineering standards, and ensure high-quality product delivery. Working closely with Sales, Architecture, Engineering, Delivery, and Product teams, the engineer will combine software engineering, cloud infrastructure, automation, testing, and AI innovation to deliver differentiated AI-native solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Translate business and technical requirements into reusable AI-enabled products using Google Cloud services and modern engineering practices.
  
Collaborate with Sales, Solution Architects, Engineering, and Delivery teams to develop scalable and repeatable AI offerings.
  
Design and build reusable agentic AI assets that accelerate deployment and adoption across client engagements.
  
Define product architecture standards, engineering frameworks, reusable design patterns, and deployment approaches.
  
Develop proof-of-concepts, pilot solutions, packaged AI assets, and reusable accelerators.
  
Ensure solutions meet scalability, security, reliability, maintainability, and operational excellence standards.
  
GCP Architecture & Cloud Engineering
  
Design reusable agent configurations using Vertex AI Agent Builder, orchestration frameworks, and AI workflow architectures.
  
Develop Infrastructure-as-Code templates, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment accelerators using Google Cloud services.
  
Create reference architectures supporting agentic AI, intelligent automation, and AI-native applications.
  
Integrate AI products with enterprise systems, APIs, cloud services, and data platforms.
  
Optimize architectures for reusability, maintainability, performance, and deployment efficiency.
  
Engineering Excellence & Quality
  
Develop testing, validation, evaluation, monitoring, and quality assurance frameworks for AI-enabled products.
  
Implement automated testing and deployment practices to ensure product reliability and consistency.
  
Establish engineering standards, coding guidelines, governance frameworks, version control, release management, and continuous improvement processes.
  
Improve engineering productivity through automation and reusable development assets.
  
Client Engagement & Collaboration
  
Partner with architects, product owners, delivery teams, and business stakeholders to align solutions with business objectives.
  
Drive AI product innovation, reusable asset development, and engineering best practices.
  
Mentor engineering teams on GCP engineering, AI product development, and agentic architecture.
  
Contribute to reusable frameworks, accelerators, thought leadership, and continuous capability development.
  
Qualifications
  
Experience
  
5–8 years of experience in Product Engineering, Software Engineering, Cloud Engineering, AI Engineering, or related fields.
  
Experience designing cloud-native applications and reusable software assets on Google Cloud Platform.
  
Hands-on experience with AI, machine learning, automation, intelligent workflows, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, and automated deployment frameworks.
  
Proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable product architectures and develop proof-of-concepts, reusable accelerators, testing frameworks, and productized assets.
  
Experience supporting enterprise AI transformation and cloud modernization initiatives.
  
  
Bonus Points
  
Proven track record building reusable AI products and cloud native engineering assets.
  
Experience developing agentic AI frameworks, evaluation accelerators, and deployment
  
templates.
  
Experience with Agile, DevOps, MLOps, and modern engineering operating models.
  
Knowledge of Vertex AI, intelligent agents, automation frameworks, and AI
  
orchestration platforms.
  
Contributions to reusable frameworks, patents, publications, innovation programs, or
  
thought leadership initiatives.

title: Application Support Engineer Copy 01
description:
**Role Overview:**  

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled GenAI Automation Specialist to join our Automation \& Asset Development \& Deployment team. This role will focus on designing, developing, and optimizing generative AI solutions using Python and large language models (LLMs). You will be instrumental in building intelligent automation workflows, refining prompt strategies, and ensuring scalable, secure AI deployments.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Design, test, and optimize prompts for LLMs to support use cases which benefit the infra \& application managed services.
  
Build and maintain Python\-based microservices and scripts for data processing, API integration, and model orchestration.
  
Collaborate with SMEs to convert business requirements into GenAI\-powered workflows, including chunking logic, token optimization, and schema transformation.
  
Work with foundation models and APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Vertex AI, Claude Sonnet) to embed GenAI capabilities into enterprise platforms.
  
Ensure all AI solutions comply with internal data privacy, PII masking, and security standards.
  
Conduct A/B testing of prompts, evaluate model outputs, and iterate based on SME feedback.
  
Maintain clear documentation of prompt strategies, model behaviours, and solution architectures.
  
  

**Required Skills:**  

Strong proficiency in Python, including experience with REST APIs, data parsing, and automation scripting.
  
Deep understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, and GenAI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, RAG pipelines).
  
Familiarity with data modelling, SQL, and RDBMS concepts.
  
Experience with agentic workflows, token optimization, and schema chunking.

title: Senior Piping Engineer
description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.


**The Role**

***As a Piping Stress Engineer with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.


* Worked as piping stress lead in various projects
* Perform pipe stress analysis using CAESAR II software, ensuring compliance with industry standards and project requirements.
* Conduct static and dynamic analysis of piping systems to evaluate performance under various operating conditions.
* Design and analyze piping support systems to ensure stability and integrity.
* Check nozzle loads to prevent mechanical failure and ensure safe operation.
* Transfer civil load data accurately for integration into piping designs.
* Prepare piping material specifications and ensure alignment with project standards.
* Conduct pipe thickness calculations to meet safety and regulatory requirements.
  

**About You**  

  

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:


* Graduate degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Power, Engineering or a related field.
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in piping stress engineering, preferably within a consultancy or EPC environment.
* Proficiency in CAESAR II software for pipe stress analysis.
* Strong understanding of piping support systems and load transfer principles.
* Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail.

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.


And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.


And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Principal Compiler Architect
description:
Posted Monday, September 21, 2026 at 11:00 PM
Software AG helps companies to manage and optimize their operations, infrastructure and technology with products that simplify complexity, increase transparency and prepare organizations for change.


Trusted by the world’s best brands for more than 50 years, Software AG’s AI\-enabled process intelligence, application development, high\-performance database, and strategic portfolio management solutions are used by banks, retailers, manufacturers, governments and more.


Software AG’s Adabas database \& Natural development platform are used by the world’s leading organizations to build and deploy high\-performance, mission\-critical applications for IBM Z®, Linux® and cloud. Governments and businesses (in finance, manufacturing, retail and more) tailor these applications to give their organization a distinct competitive advantage and optimize them to meet the most demanding operational service level agreements. With a pledge to innovate Adabas \& Natural to 2050 and beyond, we ensure our customer’s mission\-critical Adabas \& Natural applications are Future ready. Now.


Be you, join us.


**Location\- India**  

**Principal Compiler Architect**  

**The role**
COBOL applications, backed by the legendary resilience, security, and scalability of IBM Z, are among global enterprises’ most valuable assets. They run mission\-critical operations with business logic that is unique to the respective organization.
We are hiring a **Principal Compiler Architect** to own the technical direction of the compiler part of our JOPAZ product, and to grow into leading the team that builds it.  

**What you'll do**
* Own the compiler end to end


* Guard correctness as the top priority


* Define and defend how COBOL semantics map onto the JVM so that compiled programs are behaviorally equivalent to native execution


* Drive performance on the JVM


* Set the technical roadmap for the optimization strategy, make cross\-cutting design decisions, and keep the codebase coherent as it grows


* Collaborate across the product, including mainframe connectivity layers


* Grow into technical and people leadership

  

**What we're looking for (must\-have)**
* Proven, end\-to\-end compiler construction experience – you have built or substantially contributed to a production compiler; not just used compiler frameworks.


* Multi\-year JVM code expertise


* Correctness and semantics engineering


* Architecture\-level judgment for optimization strategies


* Ability to make and defend cross\-cutting technical decisions in a long\-lived codebase


* Technical leadership instincts (mentoring engineers, communicate designs clearly)

  

**Strong plus\-points (not required)**
